title: bosun decision, schema 3
description: One decision. Changes from v2: the id of a new entry is a UTC timestamp written with hyphens only, YYYY-MM-DD-HH-MM-SS. Time is recorded in UTC, fixed here rather than left to the writer, so ids from different machines and time zones sort and compare correctly. Separators are hyphens so the id is safe in filenames, URLs and shells on every platform.

id.description: Stable opaque identifier, never reused and never changed. New entries use a UTC timestamp formatted YYYY-MM-DD-HH-MM-SS, for example 2026-08-28-17-10-03. Entries from schema v1 carry a slug instead. Note that the string itself does not mark the zone: UTC is fixed by this schema.

alias.description: Short human label such as E18. Typed by people in prose.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the decision was made.

origin.description: Project the decision came from. Required so knowledge can travel and stay checkable.

author_role.description: Role, not person. The log answers why it is so, never who was wrong.

quote.description: The triggering sentence, verbatim, in the language it was said in.

rejected.description: The alternatives that lost, and why. Without these the same option gets reconsidered next time.

reason_type.description: Unglamorous values are first-class. Countable, so the claim that honest entries exist can be checked.

falsifier.description: What one would observe to know this was wrong. Required: without it the log is an archive.

supersedes.description: Ids or aliases this entry replaces. Mandatory for compression to be able to remove a stale rule.
